description: Canal Right of Way is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. Legally defined right-of-way boundary of canals within Mesa planning area. Canals supply much of the water the City uses for drinking water and irrigation of parks and open spaces. Data represents canal right-of-way from the City’s inception and is updated when changes are made to the canal Right of Way (ROW). Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. Its tags are right-of-way, srp, right, canal, water. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Information Technology. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
